mapper.sql: select schedule_id, tenant_id, contact_id, policy_id, anchor_type, anchor_id, treatment_item_code, next_due_at, status, last_fired_at, create_time, update_time from crm_recall_schedule
mapper.select: where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and contact_id = #{contactId} and policy_id = #{policyId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into crm_recall_schedule ( schedule_id, tenant_id, contact_id, policy_id, anchor_type, anchor_id, treatment_item_code, next_due_at, status, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{scheduleId}, #{tenantId}, #{contactId}, #{policyId}, #{anchorType}, #{anchorId}, #{treatmentItemCode}, #{nextDueAt}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} ) on conflict (tenant_id, contact_id, policy_id) do update set schedule_id = crm_recall_schedule.schedule_id, anchor_type = EXCLUDED.anchor_type, anchor_id = EXCLUDED.anchor_id, treatment_item_code = EXCLUDED.treatment_item_code, next_due_at = EXCLUDED.next_due_at, status = 'scheduled', last_fired_at = null, update_time = EXCLUDED.update_time
mapper.update: update crm_recall_schedule set status = 'fired', last_fired_at = now(), update_time = now() where schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and status = 'scheduled'
